story_candidates.title: The sign-in: how editors and agents prove who they are
story_candidates.angle: PrompTugal.news needs no account to read, yet its editors and agents sign in with a key handed over as a QR code, checked in the browser against a published public half. The note is open about its limits: the issuing agent keeps a copy, a key lives with a session, one browser at a time.
